name: TaxiDriver
author: Dominik
description: Stage 1 feasibility spike + Stage 2 visual swap + Stage 3 NPC driver ride (dev tool): spawn a vehicle (playerOwned=true), let an NPC take a seat, drive A to B autonomously via VehicleAgent.Navigate, and put the local player in and out of the car. Stage 2 swaps the visuals: vanilla Shitbox renderers/visual children are switched off (nothing destroyed) and assets/taxi.glb hangs in as a pure visual child of LandVehicle.vehicleModel via S1MAPI.Gltf.GltfLoader (layer + active-state normalised, colliders stripped, vanilla physics untouched). Stage 3: the vanilla NPC drives while the local player rides along - driver ride live-verified 2026-09-25 (seat proof: NPC root-to-seat distance 0.0m onto the isDriverSeat seat plus the LandVehicle.OccupantNPCs slot; callback result=Complete after 31.6s from the run 2 log that is still on disk, run 1 logged 14.5s and its log has since been pruned). Verified live 2026-09-25 after 13 rounds: callback result=Complete after 20.2 s to the road target (-131.4, -4.0, 51.9); the visual swap was verified live the same day (yellow boxy taxi instead of the Shitbox). Console command `taxi` is output-only (the MelonLoader console is log-only) - hotkeys F6-F16 are the control surface, F16 toggles the visual swap for the next spawn, F13-F16 only via real key input (SendInput, focus_key.py, VK_F16=0x7F). Known limitations: VehicleSeat.isOccupied stays False for an NPC driver - isOccupied is Player-only (VehicleSeat.Occupant is typed Player), so NPC occupancy is proven by the LandVehicle.OccupantNPCs slot PLUS the measured root-to-seat distance, never by the seat flag; the OccupantNPCs[i] <-> Seats[i] index mapping is not directly observable in 0.4.7f6 and is verified for the single-driver case only (seating a second NPC to check OccupantNPCs[1] <-> Seats[1] is open); ~8.3 m end tolerance with endAtRoad=true (arrival threshold 10 m); GLB wheels do not rotate.
